publisher: City of Creston (zoning compiled by Iowa State University Extension, Online Guide to Iowa Zoning)
filter: city = 'Creston' AND fips7 = '1917265' AND zoning NOT IN ('F', 'C-1', 'I-1')
notes: Copy of Creston zoning districts from the ISU Extension Online Guide to Iowa Zoning statewide dataset (Iowa State GIS ArcGIS Online item, amylogan@iastate.edu), not hosted by the city. Covers Creston city only; unincorporated county not covered. Commercial C-1, Light Industrial I-1 and flood plain F polygons are left out because their source geometry fails validity checks; the city zoning map is only a PDF.
